conditions.condition_text: Wait for the market to complete a minimum of four to six swings before attempting to trade a Point of Interest (POI).
The swing count acts as a filter to ensure the POI has matured and is ready for a reversal.
Enter the trade in the direction of the reversal after the swing count is met and consolidation occurs.
The reversal is confirmed after the required number of swings and a period of consolidation.
The market must complete a minimum of four to six swings before a reversal trade is considered.
The stop is placed behind the Point of Interest (POI) or the swing that defined the reversal.
